entries.name: verification-takes-sentinel-document-numbers
entries.claim: Release verification's arranged records take V- sentinel document numbers, so a release activation never consumes a tenant's real document sequence.

entries.name: added-company-column-carries-its-update-grant
entries.claim: A column a later release adds to a company-scoped table receives the same per-column UPDATE grant the table's creation gives its other mutable columns, so the materialized catalog matches the expected grants.

entries.name: replayed-create-keeps-later-column-grants
entries.claim: Replaying a company-scoped table's creation for another tenant revokes UPDATE at table level only when a table-level grant exists, so column grants a later release added for a tenant already serving it survive.

entries.name: verification-reads-records-through-a-plain-get
entries.claim: Release verification reads its probe records through the entity's plain query of each type, never a read-model query of the same type, whose executor its gateway does not register; an order read with its totals therefore cannot stop a release from activating.
